parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system services dhcp pool bas_local.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] network [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool bas_local.command: set system services dhcp pool bas_local network 10.0.0.0/16
set system services dhcp pool bas_local.explanation: 配置DHCP服务的地址池及其网络地址和子网掩码。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: DHCP地址池的子网掩码位数。

set system services dhcp pool bas_local.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] default-router [parameter2]
set system services dhcp pool bas_local.command: set system services dhcp pool bas_local default-router 10.0.0.1
set system services dhcp pool bas_local.explanation: 配置DHCP地址池的默认网关。

parameters.name: default-router
parameters.explanation: DHCP地址池的默认网关地址。

set system authentication-order local.explanation: 配置系统认证顺序为本地认证。

set system accounting-order local.explanation: 配置系统计费顺序为本地计费。
